* Automation Test Analyst is expected to work under the guidance of leads/Senior Analysts and would be instrumental in developing solutions approved by the Automation Test Architect or Test Manager. Should have a fair understanding of automation testing frameworks and techniques.

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves

* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance

**Your skills and experience**

* Should have 12\+ years total test experience with 5\+ years of relevant automation experience
* Strong programming and development skills in Cucumber, Selenium, Java
* Strong and Database and SQL knowledge.
* Experience in python is desirable
* Hands\-on working experience on Test Automation using one or more techniques: Data Driven, Keyword Driven and Hybrid Framework.
* Should be good at problem solving and debugging with excellent analytical skills
* Hands\-on working experience in regression test suite maintenance (Fitnesse/Selenium)
* Should be able to analyse manual UAT test cases, specs, business processes and requirements and convert
* Proactive and assertive attitude
* Good in verbal \& written communication
* Knowledge of Investment Banking domain added advantage
* Good understanding of STLC and latest test methodologies and processes.
* Hands on working knowledge of automation tool UTF (and/or Selenium).
* Should have worked in ETL/Data Warehouse projects/programs.
* Proactive, disciplined and good sense of time management

**Skills/ Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Degree/Masters engineering or software/technology related subject (or equivalent certification and/or relevant work experience)

**Industry / Domain Experience: Desirable**

Hands\-on knowledge of enterprise technology platforms supporting the Finance, Risk and Treasury domains would be an advantage. For example:


* Knowledge of the Finance/controlling domain and end\-to\-end workflow for a banking \& trading businesses.
* Knowledge of Treasury: liquidity, funding, capital and collateral; and their management in a large financial institution.
* Knowledge of the investment banking, sales \& trading, asset management and similar industries is a strong advantage.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:


**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

title: Automation Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Regional Customer Support Manager \#\#\#


**Your role and responsibilities**



In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost\-effective manner. You will also showcase your skills by applying basic design thinking/design best practices concepts in projects.



The work model for the role is: \#LI \- Onsite



This role is contributing to the machine automation within ABB's Automation division in Pune/Ahmedabad\-India region. Main stakeholders include Customers, Application Engineers, Sales Teams, Engineering Teams, Global Product Support/HQ Teams, Training Participants, Project Teams, and OEM/Manufacturing Customers.


**You will be mainly accountable for:**


* Providing pre\-sales and post\-sales technical support to customers and application engineers, resolving product, software, and application\-related issues through remote support channels.
* Identifying and diagnosing automation system challenges, delivering timely solutions to ensure optimal system performance and customer satisfaction.
* Building and maintaining positive customer relationships by facilitating effective communication and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
* Planning and executing technical support activities, including issue escalation, problem resolution, and collaboration with global teams to implement innovative solutions and best practices.
* Developing skills in automation products and real\-time software applications while supporting knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
* Delivering technical training and application engineering support, including software development, commissioning, documentation, and reporting of technical activities


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Electrical \& Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or a related discipline).
* 1\-5 years of experience in application development, commissioning, and technical support within industrial automation environments, with experience in multinational organizations.
* Solid knowledge of Industrial Automation systems, including PLCs, HMIs, Servo Drives, Motion Control, Motors, Robotics, and integrated machine automation solutions.
* Practical experience in application engineering, problem solving, customer support, commissioning, and deployment of automation solutions.
* Good understanding of control theory, structured programming, and software development practices, with proficiency in C/ST programming preferred.
* Knowledge of electronics, mechanics, and applied mathematics, with experience supporting industries such as Food \& Beverage (F\&B), CPG, and Consumer Goods.
* Excellent communication, customer engagement, and training skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross\-functional and customer\-focused environments.


**More about us:**



B\&R Industrial Automation is a manufacturer of automation technology and ABB's global center for machine and factory automation. B\&R was founded in 1979 by Erwin Bernecker and Josef Rainer and has its headquarters in Eggelsberg, Upper Austria. Today, B\&R is a leading global solution provider for automating machines and factories and is responsible for machine automation in ABB's Robotics \& Discrete Automation division.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
